fact: Liberia's National Identification Registry executive director says it plans to link national ID with civil registration and vital statistics in one NID-CRVS system under a signed $54 million agreement with OSD that awaits parliamentary approval.

The Liberian Observer reports a proposed NIDCRVS concession with OeSD International GmbH, referred to a House joint committee on 2026-10-13, would integrate national identification with civil registration in one digital platform.

Liberia's National Identification Registry executive director Andrew Peters said the ID upgrade includes a component to link the civil registration and national ID systems in a life cycle identity management architecture.

The signed OeSD concession proposes integrating national identification with Liberia's civil registration and vital statistics system, but implementation awaits legislative ratification, NIR Executive Director Andrew Peters said on 4 September 2026.
